source: PAYS 2025 district profile reports (PCCD/Bach Harrison), from CSIU Google Drive
method: Full PDFs downloaded from Drive, converted with pdftotext -layout, tables parsed programmatically (grade rows x District 2021/2023/2025/State 2025/MTF-BH columns); all-grades values cross-checked against the reports' narrative text. State comparison = Pennsylvania 2025. Values are percentages unless noted.

gambling_past_year.note: report gives lifetime and past-30-day any-gambling only; past-12-month is only reported by gambling type

bullied_past_year.derivation: 100 minus 'No [not bullied in the past 12 months]'

districts.notes: gambling_past_year not reported as an 'any gambling' figure; report gives lifetime and past-30-day any-gambling (captured) and past-12-month rates only by gambling type. bullied_past_year derived as 100 minus 'No [not bullied in past 12 months]' from the Frequency of bullying table; matches the report narrative. Risk/protective factor values are '% of students at risk / with protection' (Bach Harrison cut-points); full by-grade scales in risk_factors_full / protective_factors_full with District 2021/2023/2025, State 2025 and BH Norm columns. 'state' = Pennsylvania 2025 all-grades value shown beside the district value; state_by_grade gives the state value per grade. table 'mh': wrapped header; columns inferred from value count (4 per measure) Confidence basis: table values were parsed from the full PDF text (pdftotext) and the all-grades values for depressive symptoms, suicidal ideation, bullying and gambling all match the report's narrative sentences.

trends.notes: 2019-2025 mental-health items come from 'CSIU 16 PAYS Cross-Sectional Trends 2019-2025' (Runge & Knoster, Summer 2026; file 1-gbjLXDFb9_yxXLmozOB62rhqF6sJHum), read from the bar-chart data labels in Figures 1-10 and cross-checked against the narrative (e.g. ideation 18.6/16.2/15.6, plan 14.3/13.1/12.4, attempts 11.1/5.9/5.3 for 2021/2023/2025; self-harm -1.1 pts and attempts -5.0 pts 2019->2025). Comparison group there is 'all other IUs' (rest of PA), not the full state. Substance-use, school-safety, bullying and gambling trend values for 2021/2023/2025 come from the IU 2021/IU 2023/IU 2025 columns of the 2025 CSIU 16 profile report; no 2019 values for those indicators were available in either document. IU participation: 2021 n=6,382 (68.1%), 2023 n=5,955 (62.6%), 2025 n=6,267 (71.1%); 2019 n=6,442 (participation rate not available). Trend report caveat: 2023/2025 suicide-attempt question changed to yes/no, limiting comparability with 2019/2021.
